<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Telehealth Dashboard</title>
<meta name="robots" content="noindex,nofollow">
<style>body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#f5f4f0;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;color:#1f1f1e}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){body{background:#1d1d1c;color:#eceae5}.box{background:#262624!important;border-color:#3a3936!important}input{background:#1d1d1c;color:#eceae5;border-color:#3a3936!important}}
.box{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e3e1db;border-radius:12px;padding:28px;width:min(340px,90vw);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:24px;margin:0 0 6px}p{margin:0 0 16px;color:#6b6a66;font-size:14px}
input[type=password]{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px 12px;font-size:16px;border:1px solid #e3e1db;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
label{font-size:13px;color:#6b6a66;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
button{width:100%;padding:10px;font-size:15px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#3b6fd1;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}#err{color:#c62828;font-size:13px;min-height:18px;margin-top:8px}</style></head>
<body><div class="box"><h1>Telehealth Dashboard</h1><p>Enter your password to open.</p>
<input id="pw" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" autofocus>
<label><input id="rem" type="checkbox"> Remember on this device</label>
<button id="go">Open</button><div id="err"></div></div>
<script>
const D={s:"mc4iwm4T8FR65CryPQ5VWQ==",i:"OfkR/LfQlIdL8h5O",c:"",n:250000};
const u=s=>Uint8Array.from(atob(s),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));
async function open_(pw,quiet){
  try{
    const base=await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw',new TextEncoder().encode(pw),'PBKDF2',false,['deriveKey']);
    const key=await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({name:'PBKDF2',salt:u(D.s),iterations:D.n,hash:'SHA-256'},base,{name:'AES-GCM',length:256},false,['decrypt']);
    const pt=await crypto.subtle.decrypt({name:'AES-GCM',iv:u(D.i)},key,u(D.c));
    if(document.getElementById('rem').checked){try{localStorage.setItem('tl_pw',pw)}catch(e){}}
    const html=new TextDecoder().decode(pt);document.open();document.write(html);document.close();
  }catch(e){ if(!quiet) document.getElementById('err').textContent='Wrong password.'; try{if(quiet)localStorage.removeItem('tl_pw')}catch(_){} }
}
document.getElementById('go').onclick=()=>open_(document.getElementById('pw').value);
document.getElementById('pw').addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')open_(e.target.value)});
try{const s=localStorage.getItem('tl_pw'); if(s){document.getElementById('rem').checked=true; open_(s,true);}}catch(e){}
</script></body></html>
